event_chain.summary: Customer funds lost, method and actor unknown

summary: In December 2023 Canadian crypto exchange Catalyx, operated by CatalX CTX Ltd., froze trading, deposits and withdrawals after a security breach in which some customer funds were lost. The Alberta Securities Commission ordered a trading halt on December 21 and the CEO consented to a 15-day freeze order. The investigation may involve an employee; the amount lost was not disclosed.
